719:t_001:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「True, feelings have been poured into that thing too. But they run contrary to what we are... They are close to the force that seeks to vanish.」

719:t_001:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If I had to sum it up in one word, 'a mass of curses' would be the fitting description.」

719:t_001:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I believe it is something like a prison confining the $$御使い$$ of Sorrow.」

719:t_001:16.en:
$$セツコ$$
「As proof, even though we are this close, the feelings coming from there are so faint they seem about to fade away.」

719:t_001:17.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「So the power of that person is being sealed by other $$御使い$$s.」

719:t_001:18.en:
$$トビー$$
「But hey, doesn't that seem off? Those guys are a bunch of vicious monsters who'd even crush a galaxy, right?」

719:t_001:19.en:
$$トビー$$
「Then if there was a traitor among them, why not just execute the traitor or something, right away?」

719:t_001:20.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「They go easy on their own kind... Is that it?」

719:t_001:21.en:
$$トライア$$
「Anyway, it looks like Miss Sorrow is definitely in there...!」

719:t_002:0.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「So you've shown yourself, $$御使い$$!」

719:t_002:1.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then, everyone in the mobile force, please launch.」

719:t_003:0.en:
$$赤木$$
「I knew it, there's an $$御使い$$ inside that crystal who's on our side!」

719:t_003:1.en:
$$桂$$
「So an evil dragon is here to greet us, who came to rescue the captive princess.」

719:t_003:2.en:
???
「You guys really are the upbeat type.」

719:t_004:0.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Welcome to $$カオス・コスモス$$. Today, $$テンプティ$$ will be welcoming you all.」

719:t_004:2.en:
$$万丈$$
「Thank you for the very polite welcome. Will you be taking us on yourself, in the flesh?」

719:t_004:3.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「No way! That's $$ドクトリン$$ and $$アドヴェント#pilot$$'s job.」

719:t_004:4.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「$$テンプティ$$ is just going to have fun playing with dolls.」

719:t_005:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「What's going on!? I can feel $$テンプティ$$'s presence from every single $$エル・ミレニウム$$!」

719:t_005:2.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「It's simple. I'm sending a part of $$テンプティ$$'s consciousness into those kids.」

719:t_005:3.en:
$$葵$$
「Are you saying you're remote-controlling every unit!?」

719:t_005:4.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「It's a little different from piloting... $$テンプティ$$'s consciousness is fused with those kids, after all.」

719:t_005:6.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「That's right. It's the same kind of thing as your $$真化融合$$.」

719:t_005:7.en:
$$アマタ$$
「They can do $$真化融合$$ too...!」

719:t_005:8.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Of course they can. We're the ones who have touched the truth of the universe and know the essence of $$次元力$$...」

719:t_005:9.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「We're $$御使い$$s, after all.」

719:t_005:12.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「No, no! We're not that full of ourselves!」

719:t_005:13.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「We're servants of God... And by God, I mean the Supreme God.」

719:t_005:14.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The Supreme God... So that's the source of their power...!」

719:t_005:15.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Well then, shall we get started? A game of playing house, full of despair.」

719:t_005:16.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「So, how do you feel now? Like someone dumped ice water on you just when you were getting cocky?」

719:t_005:17.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Shut up! We haven't lost yet!」

719:t_005:18.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Hahahaha! I love that positive attitude of yours!」

719:t_005:19.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Well then, do your best! $$テンプティ$$ will be cheering you on from the back!」

719:t_006:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「That woman's playing around with us every step of the way...!」

719:t_006:1.en:
$$タケル$$
「$$楽しみのテンプティ$$... Just like her name, she spreads malice so innocently...!」

719:t_006:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「Then we'll just crush that malice!」

719:t_006:3.en:
$$シャア$$
「All units, go after $$エル・ミレニウム$$! They are the core of the enemy force!」

719:t_006:4.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「That's easy to say, but the $$アンチスパイラル$$'s battleship covered in faces is out on the front line too!」

719:t_006:5.en:
$$シモン$$
「We'll just punch through all of it! For the sake of our promise with the $$アンチスパイラル$$, too!」

719:t_007:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「I smashed all of her dolls!」

719:t_007:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Now the real one will come out...?」

719:t_008:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「She still had that much force left!」

719:t_008:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Amazing, you guys! You beat $$テンプティ$$'s dolls!」

719:t_008:2.en:
$$刹那$$
「True, the $$エル・ミレニウム$$ you controlled were stronger than any before...!」

719:t_008:3.en:
$$赤木$$
「But you know what! You can't beat the bond between us and our machines, who've shared every hardship and joy together!」

719:t_008:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Has she gone crazy from the shock of her trump card losing...!?」

719:t_008:7.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「You guys really are the best! The best way to kill time in the last 120 million years!」

719:t_008:9.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You! Do you intend to destroy Earth and other planets as if it were a game!」

719:t_008:10.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Never mind the other three, that's $$テンプティ$$'s job.」

719:t_008:11.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Anyway, we'll crush you with numbers. There are as many spare dolls as you could want.」

719:t_009:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Fly, $$シュロウガ$$! Tear through fate with those black wings!」

719:t_010:0.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「$$エル・ミレニウム$$ is...!」

719:t_010:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Your doll-play is over now, $$楽しみのテンプティ$$!」

719:t_011:0.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「$$御使い$$s are eternal. You know it's pointless to do this, don't you?」

719:t_011:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「But for a moment, I got to see your frustrated face.」

719:t_011:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I told you, $$テンプティ$$! Your doll-play is over!」

719:t_011:4.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Sooner or later, all of you will be embraced by these black wings of sin! And then you'll fall into the bottomless dark!」

719:t_011:5.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「$$アサキム・ドーウィン$$! Giving you eternity was a mistake! The next time we meet, I'll punish you!」

719:t_012:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「...Though I doubt that what you call punishment would truly make me suffer...」

719:t_012:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I'll deal with you later.」

719:t_013:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「As expected, I can't break the barrier that easily.」

719:t_013:1.en:
$$シン$$
「What are you doing, $$アサキム$$!?」

719:t_013:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I will take revenge on every $$御使い$$. On those who bound me with the chains of eternity.」

719:t_013:3.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Not happening! We've got business with the woman on that planet!」
